hk3.title: Pokemon TCG 30th Celebration Card Set Complete All 9 Types Japanese Sealed
hk3.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
hk3.details: Pokemon TCG Japanese 30th Celebration Card Set, complete set of all 9 types. Nine sealed sets covering the starter Pokemon of each region: Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar and Paldea. According to the package, each set contains 3 foil promo cards and 2 expansion packs. Brand new and unopened. Japanese language. The packages are shipped as they are, unopened.
hk3.why: A complete set of all nine 30th Celebration card sets, one for each region's starter Pokemon, with foil promo cards and expansion packs in each.
hk3.perfect: Pokemon card collectors and fans who want the complete 30th Celebration card set lineup.
hk3.exp: A new, unopened complete set of nine 30th Celebration card sets.
hk3.cd: Brand new and unopened. All 9 sets are sealed.
